basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming home in the heart of the Excelsior District, offering an exciting opportunity to update and create your dream home in one of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods. Inside, you'll find a spacious layout with a large eat-in kitchen, original hardwood floors, and a beautiful brick fireplace.  There's character and classic features throughout.  Outside, the backyard provides a private space that’s ready for your transformation, whether you envision a garden oasis or a more functional outdoor living area. Just steps from the best of the Excelsior, including shops, cafes, easy access to freeways and public transportation, making commuting a breeze - Close to McLaren Park and Crocker Amazon Park offering  the perfect opportunity for a lifestyle upgrade for your family.
